placeholder.list: e.g. I1-I8, Q1-Q4, M1, MW3, MD6, IA1, CLOCK

writeMode.msg: From the message (msg.payload as object or msg.topic)

op.ND: ND – NET marker double word (own device)

test.okClock: Connection OK – clock of the easyE4: __clock__
test.okMw: Connection OK – MW1 = __value__ (clock data is not enabled in easySoft)
test.okNoData: Connection OK – the easyE4 answers, but neither clock data nor MW1 are enabled (easySoft: Modbus server tab)
test.switched: – addressing was switched to "__mode__", please click Update.

exception.1: Function not supported by the easyE4
exception.2: Address does not exist or is not enabled in easySoft (Modbus server tab)
exception.2w: Cannot write: address not enabled, "read only" or "clock setting locked" (easySoft: Modbus server tab)

errors.noHost: No address of the easyE4 entered
errors.queueFull: Too many waiting requests – increase the poll interval
errors.indexRangeFw: __what__: with the selected firmware only up to __max__ (more with firmware 2.40 or later)
errors.rangeOrder: Range: the end must be greater than or equal to the start
errors.badOperand: "__text__" is not a valid operand (examples: MW3, Q1, IA2, M1-M16, CLOCK)
errors.noElementInMsg: No operands in msg.topic or msg.payload (e.g. "MW3, Q1")
errors.badBool: "__value__" is not a bit value (true/false, 1/0, on/off)
errors.badNumber: __what__: "__value__" must be an integer from __min__ to __max__
errors.notWritable: __type__ cannot be written via Modbus (only M, MB, MW, MD, N, NB, NW, ND)
errors.badFc: Function code __fc__ is not possible here
errors.badAddr: Register no. must be between 1 and 65536
errors.noWriteTarget: What should be written? msg.payload as object (e.g. {"MW3": 5}) or msg.topic with operand

tips.device: In easySoft 8: Project view → Modbus server tab → Modbus TCP server active, enable the marker/NET marker range, for inputs/outputs and clock Enable read I/O and clock data. Port 502 (adjustable with firmware 2.30 or later).
tips.read: Bits are output as 0/1, words as numbers. Read many values with Several (list) – they are fetched with as few requests as possible.
tips.write: Only markers and own NET markers (M, MB, MW, MD, N, NB, NW, ND) and the clock can be written. Inputs and outputs cannot be written via Modbus.
